text:
alaine: FYI after the infra driver bump (nvidia-driver 556.78 -> 559.01) we started seeing a latency tail on chat workloads around 10:40 UTC, looks correlated with seqlen=32/64 requests. small multi-turn chats spiking 2-3x p50 -> p95.
samir: ugh, saw that on staging too. autotuner flipped preferred kernel for short sequences to `vec-attn-opt` on H100, which appears to skip the KV-cache fast-path. regression vs previous `kv-friendly-attn-v3`.
hazel: can you paste the profiler snapshot? curious if batching heuristics also changed.
alaine: paste of perf snippet from trace (shortened):
```
model: redwood-conv-8b | seq:64 | kernel: vec-attn-opt | kv_cache_hit: 18% | tokens/s: 1.2k
previous baseline:
model: redwood-conv-8b | seq:64 | kernel: kv-friendly-attn-v3 | kv_cache_hit: 92% | tokens/s: 2.6k
```
alaine: also seeing higher GPU memcpy times in the hot loop, likely due to different KV layout assumption.
jon-rl: autotuner heuristics changed with the new cuda libs; kernel selection scoring now weighs raw FLOPS more which advantages vec-attn-opt for tiny sequences. but it doesn't account for multi-turn KV reuse.
samir: proposed rollback: pin driver on affected fleet to 556.78 and force older autotune profile for seqlen <= 128 until we ship a patch. can we do a targeted rollback to the canary pool first?
hazel: yes we should canary rollback on region-us-west-2 first. ops: schedule for next 15m, monitor p50/p95 and kv_cache_hit metric. if green, roll through the rest but keep bandwidth throttled.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued -> job_id=rb-2026-03-18-01, target=us-west-2-canary, rollback_version=556.78, expected_downtime=0, start_eta=2026-03-18T01:05:00Z :white_check_mark:
samir: also adding a short-term autotune override: prefer kernel `kv-friendly-attn-v3` when model.meta.prefers_kv_path == true or when session.turns > 1. will open PR for runtime rule and a quick unit test.
alaine: thanks. i'll keep an eye on traces and surface any anomalies. please @here if we see any degraded SLOs after rollback. :thumbsup
